title: Foodborne Illness
description: Plain-text guide to food poisoning: emergency signs including botulism, when to see a doctor, symptom onset by germ, and home treatment with oral rehydration. Covers medicines, preventing spread, clean-separate-cook-chill, and high-risk foods in emergencies.
shortDescription: When food poisoning needs 911 or a doctor, rehydration, and preventing spread
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
